name: rage
tagline: the synth is screaming and so is the crowd
description: Trap with the volume knob snapped off: looping, stereo-wide synth leads, bass that clips on purpose and ad-libs over everything. Popularized by Playboi Carti, Trippie Redd and Lil Uzi Vert, then turned into a uniform by Opium. Built for the pit, not the car.
